:::{#lem-markov-chain-conditional-mutual-information}
#### Conditional mutual information along a Markov chain

If $X \to Y \to Z$ is a [Markov chain](#def-markov-chain)
and the [entropies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of $X$, $Y$ and $Z$ are finite,
then

$$\cmutinfof{Z}{X}{Y} = 0.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

Fix values $y$ and $z$ with $\P(Y=y, Z=z) > 0$.
Dividing the defining equation of the chain by $\P(Z=z \mid Y=y)$ gives

$$\P(X=x \mid Y=y, Z=z) = \P(X=x \mid Y=y)$$

for every $x$.
So the [entropy given](#def-entropy-given-value) $(Y, Z) = (y, z)$ is the entropy given $Y = y$.
Averaging over $(Y, Z)$ and over $Y$ gives

$$\entropyf{X \mid Y, Z} = \entropyf{X \mid Y}.$$

By @def-conditional-mutual-information,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\cmutinfof{Z}{X}{Y}
&= \entropyf{X \mid Y} - \entropyf{X \mid Z, Y} \\
&= \entropyf{X \mid Y} - \entropyf{X \mid Y, Z} \\
&= 0.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
